en-US.summary: Find and cook recipes with step-by-step voice guidance
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask cooking captain to find pasta
Alexa, ask cooking captain for chocolate cake
en-US.name: Cooking Captain
en-US.description: Cooking Captain is your voice-activated kitchen assistant. Search for recipes by name or ingredient, then get step-by-step cooking instructions read aloud. Perfect for hands-free cooking!

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Open the skill and ask for a recipe by name.
